debates.rule: verified: every cited id resolves to a saved record or a tool result, and every quote is a substring of the cited source (compare.quote_ok). cited: ids resolve, no quote. unverified: an id does not resolve or a quote is not in the source. echo: an uncited quote of the opponent's words; not counted in claims.
